prompt:

Palette: #F6F1E3, #1F2D3D, #B8860B, #4F6D5A, #8C7A6B.

Character Cast: Warm scholarly human presenter with wavy dark hair, round brass spectacles, and flat olive-tweed vest over rolled white sleeves, holding a fountain pen or open leather notebook. Outfit: Flat olive-tweed vest over crisp rolled-sleeve ivory oxford shirt with brass spectacles, no shading.

Scene Composition: Position the character strictly on the far left 35% of the widescreen canvas, smiling and pointing toward the right. CRITICAL END-SCREEN RULE: The entire right 65% of the frame must remain completely flat, empty, solid background canvas (#F6F1E3) with strictly zero characters, zero text, zero props, and zero decorations so YouTube video/subscribe cards can overlay cleanly.

Emphasis lettering instruction: render exact uppercase Vietnamese hand-lettered text (crisp high-contrast dark ink lettering) strictly on the far left 35% of the canvas integrated directly onto the flat canvas (#F6F1E3) (strictly zero rectangular text cards, banners, or gradient overlays covering artwork): "BẢN ĐẦY ĐỦ TRÊN YOUTUBE" and "LA BÀN HỌC THUẬT".
